body.name: Two-donor, two-atom face-plus-collision certification instance
body.construction: Use the common outcome interval \([0,2]\), so \(D=2\), and set \(J=2\), \(S=2\), \(T_0=T_1=1\), \(f_{\min}=1/2\), \(f_{\max}=2\), and \(L_f=4\). In the pre period let \(Q_{1,1,\ell}(u)=u\), \(Q_{2,1,\ell}(u)=u+\tfrac25u(1-u)\), \(w_\ell=(1-h_f/\sqrt{n_\ell},h_f/\sqrt{n_\ell})\), and \(Q^N_{0,1,\ell}=w_{\ell1}Q_{1,1,\ell}+w_{\ell2}Q_{2,1,\ell}\). In the post period let donor one put mass \(1/2+h_c/\sqrt{m_\ell}\) at \(0\) and the remaining mass at \(1\), let donor two put masses \(1/2\) at \(0\) and \(2\), let the treated intervention law put masses \(1/2\) at \(0\) and \(1\), and define the no-intervention counterfactual by \(Q^N_{0,2,\ell}=w_{\ell1}Q_{1,2,\ell}+w_{\ell2}Q_{2,2,\ell}\). Each treated and donor pre cell has \(n_\ell\) independent observations, and each observed treated or donor post cell has \(m_\ell\) independent observations. Take \(0\leq h_f\leq\sqrt{n_\ell}\), \(0\leq h_c\leq\sqrt{m_\ell}/2\), and \(0<\lambda\leq1/375\). These clauses fix the triangular array and its induced local experiment \(\mathfrak E_{2,2}(h_f,h_c)\).
